page.overview:
Who is Enmity?

is a demon aspirant in the Candescent Creed, and one of the three sisters of Tyranny. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Enmity is extremely tall, with deep speckled red and black skin like lava congealing into stone. She wears very bright white priestly garb, and her horns are curled and ram-like.

Enmity appears to be the leader among the three, frequently being the one to give orders and make the final decision.

Enmity was present at the execution of Thjazi Fang, accompanying Wicander Halovar's father Godard Halovar, and greeted Tyranny. The next day, at the Villa Aurora, Tyranny met all three of her sisters again. Enmity asked if Wicander had acquitted himself well at the funeral. After telling her to "Remember where you are from, and what you are," the sisters moved on to other, more important activities.
